fields.FIR_Description: According to the complaint registered on 2025-08-13, construction materials valued at around Rs. 2,00,000 was found missing from a premises near Sevvanthi Puram Industrial Area. The incident is stated to have occurred on 2025-08-12 at about 23:35. Saravanan Murugan reported the matter orally at Chittoor North PS; the contact number given was 9000000269. No independent witness was identified at the time of registration. Karthik Thangaraj (mobile 9000000053) was named as a possible person of interest. A further person, Hariharan Subramani, a relative of the suspect, using the number 9000000044, is stated to be associated with the incident. The complainant mentioned CCTV footage and a call detail reference.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Suspect allegedly entered through an unsecured entry point.
fields.Keywords: property theft, valuables, suspect, CCTV, industrial area, call detail, night, associate
